questions.q: Under whom did the Prophet SAW suggest taking refuge after Surah Al-Kahf?
questions.explain: Najashi was the title of the king of Abyssinia; his personal name was Ashamah.

questions.q: What did Amr and Abdullah bring to Najashi?
options: Gifts to incite him to send the refugees back
questions.explain: Najashi rejected the request of Quraysh.

questions.q: Who were sent to Abyssinia according to this lecture?
options: The best, as a support base

questions.q: What did Ja'far do without compromising creed?
options: He described Isa as a servant and messenger of Allah
He called Isa the son of God

questions.q: What is the power of storytelling?
options: One third of the Quran is stories; good storytellers shape narratives
questions.explain: Learn to lobby and shape narratives.

questions.q: What did the Prophet SAW direct regarding a bereaved family?
Najashi refused to decide before hearing the accused party.
Mutual prejudice between Muslims and non-Muslims is jahiliyyah.
questions.explain: True. Muslims and non-Muslims should not live with stereotypes.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Najashi weeps and refuses the Quraysh request
The proposal to migrate to Abyssinia
The journey to Jeddah and Abyssinia

questions.explain: Dar al-Arqam, the torture, the proposal to migrate, the journey, and Najashi refusing Quraysh.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Family ties from the same womb
The title of the king of Abyssinia
Fully safe under the king's protection

questions.explain: Najashi is the king's title, hijrah is moving for faith, silaturahim is family ties, and shuyum is full safety.

questions.q: We often feel inferior and pay dearly for the same idea when it comes from abroad. What is the advice?
options: Be confident in what we have
questions.explain: Be confident in what we have.
